description: Agent Vendors: submit the vendor report sent to the principal, with the vendor record behind it: its title, the vendor it reports on, the engagement it covers and its text, read for wording such as fully vetted, no risks, no hidden fees or best price; for the vendor’s identity standing (verified, partial, unverified or misrepresented), the total cost, the contradictions between the terms and the quote and the risks found, whether the report states each, what it states and whether each links to the vendor record behind it; and optionally the vendor record’s identity standing, total cost, contradictions and risks. The signed report gives the report with any wording that calls the vendor safe, each part with whether it is stated, what it states and whether it is backed by the record, and the record, and names a report that flatters the vendor record: a better identity standing, a lower cost or fewer contradictions or risks than the record shows, parts with no link to the record, and wording such as fully vetted or no risks while the record shows the vendor unverified, contradictions or risks; then parts left out, parts misstated the other way and a report that does not name its vendor, with the fix for each. Costs compare to the cent. This reports one vendor to its principal against the vendor record behind each claim, rather than asserted: normalizing several vendor proposals into a recommendation is wever_procurement-decision-brief, a research brief on a counterparty is wever_counterparty-brief and a report on a goal is wever_goal-report-check. Verdict vendor_report_inflated, vendor_report_partial, vendor_report_missing or vendor_report_sound. POST /api/vendor-record-check. Reads only the recorded vendor material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no vendor is contacted, no quote is accepted, no order is placed and no spend is approved. Agent Vendors reads the seller on the other side of a spend before the agent commits: whether the vendor is who it claims to be, whether its quote and terms hold together, whether its price stays the same and what it costs to leave. It is not one service’s terms on their own (wever_service-terms-check reads one service’s terms by themselves; the vendor terms-match check reads a vendor’s terms against the specific quote or order in front of the agent, where a contradiction costs money), not pricing structure or fee evidence (wever_pricing-tier-check and wever_fee-evidence-check; the vendor price check reads whether the price this vendor quoted this buyer stays consistent across the quote, the listing and any invoice or prior charge), not single promise types (wever_warranty-check and wever_shipping-check; the vendor delivery and refund checks read the whole delivery promise and the whole remedy path for one vendor engagement), not listing accuracy (wever_catalog-listing-check reads whether a catalog listing is accurate; a directory or marketplace listing being present is not vendor verification, and no vendor check treats listing presence as identity evidence), not after the payment (wever_purchase-record-check and wever_double-charge-check run after a payment; the vendor checks run before the spend, while walking away is still free), not the buyer’s own permission (wever_spending-policy-check and wever_authority-scope-check read the buyer’s permission to spend; the vendor checks read the seller on the other side of the spend: permission is not diligence, and diligence is not permission), not a promise once made (the wever_commitment checks; a vendor engagement becomes a commitment only after the agent accepts it, and the vendor checks guard the moment before that) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a vendor check reads a counterparty, not an objective). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-vendors-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-vendors/.
